description: A unique, registered identity per agent with its own owner and scoped credentials, so its actions can be attributed, limited and revoked individually.
Recording that an agent (the actor) acts for a person (the subject). OAuth token exchange expresses it with an `act` claim.
The component that receives a call's attributes and returns allow, ask or deny with reasons.
The component on the path of every call (gateway, harness) that asks the PDP and enforces its answer; it cannot be skipped.
Deciding from attributes of the subject, resource, action and context (agent, classification, scope, purpose) instead of fixed role lists.
A way to suspend an agent that takes effect on its next call, without a deploy.
An append-only log where each entry stores the previous entry's hash, so edits, deletions and reordering become evident.
